text:
anna: FYI customer Y pushed for two things: per-route cost attribution and an easy way to link costly requests to errors (stack + short trace). They want a proposal by end of sprint.

rao: Understood. We currently emit high-level metrics (tokens, model, region) but not fine-grained stage timings. We can add lightweight events for queue_ms, kernel_ms, and post_ms.

claire: From console POV, customers want an aggregated cost dashboard and the ability to click into a sampled request trace with error flags. UX should be a top-line cost number + a heatmap of hot routes.

dave: Important constraint: kernel timing capture must be <=0.5us extra per token on hot path. We'll use a single timestamp delta at request end and attribute via recorded markers.

sara: Billing note: CSV export needs columns: invoice_customer_id, request_id, route, model, estimated_cost_cents, timestamp. No request payloads. Also needs consistent customer mapping.

anna: (typo, meant anna) Acceptance idea: MVP "Showback Lite" with: 1) per-request cost event (emitted 100% but tiny); 2) 0.5% sampled full spans (api, queue, batch, kernel, post) for debug; 3) two console widgets: per-route cost trend + recent sampled error traces.

rao: Estimate: 3 dev-weeks total split: 1.2w runtime instrumentation + 1w ingestion & mapping pipeline + 0.8w console tiles & CSV endpoint. Risks: pricing table granularity for quantized vs fp models. Need product+finance decision.

claire: UX note: sample viewer must show span durations and highlight any span with error status or nonzero stderr. If sampled trace is missing, show nearby request histogram.

dave: Implementation choices: emit a flat JSON event with event_type="inference_cost_v1" including request_id, model, instance_type, queue_ms, kernel_ms, post_ms, kvcache_ms, estimated_cost_cents. Keep schema minimal to avoid extra parsing on dataplane.

sara: For cost calc we need an instance_pricing table keyed by instance_type+region+model_variant. I can sync with finance but we need a schema for variants.

anna: Acceptance criteria (short): - cost estimate within 15% for 90% of sampled requests - console shows per-route cost and p95 kernel latency - CSV export for invoicing + sample trace viewer with error link - telemetry overhead <1% p99 and ability to disable sampling via FF

rao: Canary plan: start sampling only on internal org and two pilot customers for 72h. Run a backfill job to compare invoice calc vs sample aggregate. If variance >20% for a customer, pause and investigate.

claire: UX deliverables: wireframes for dashboard tiles, sample trace modal, and CSV download button. I'll attach mocks to the RFC.

dave: Runtime flagging: we add a runtime gate to disable span sampling per-customer and a global kill switch. We'll log overhead counters and a metric we monitor.

sara: CSV privacy: include customer_id and request_id only. No prompt text or tokens. Also include anonymized model hash, not full model weights name (customer ok with model alias).

anna: Dependencies: finance pricing owner (sara), infra feature-flag (eng-infra), and console storage for sampled traces (eng-platform). Who volunteers for owning RFC?

rao: I'll draft a short RFC: schema, rollout plan, perf budget, and acceptance tests. Can pair with Claire for UX.

claire: I'll prioritize mockups this sprint and join the RFC review.

sara: I'll pull a pricing extract and propose mapping rules by Wednesday.

infra-bot: deploy note: feature flag scaffold created on staging. Flag: ff.cost-trace-samples. Staging rollout scheduled 2026-04-07T08:00Z.

anna: Great. Next meeting: quick sync Thursday 10am to review RFC draft and mocks. Thanks all :rocket:
